kind.description: What made the change: a developer, a user of the app, a server key of the app, or the platform itself.

id.description: The id of the developer, app user or server key. The nil id for the platform.

label.description: A name to show: the person's display name, the name of a server key, `Fleetless`, `Deleted user` when the user no longer exists, or `Deleted key` when the key does. A person without a display name reads as their email address to a developer or a server key and to themselves, and to an app user reading someone else as `Team member` (a developer) or `User` (an app user): an app user never learns another person's address.

published_by.description: Who or what made a change to a record.

effect_counts.description: For each kind of effect the publish had, how many records or values it touched, by effect `kind`. Empty when it had none.

restored_from.description: The version this one restored. Null for an ordinary publish.

restore_with_data.description: Whether restoring this version can also put records back: its restore point is at most 90 days old, has not been purged, and it is not the current version.

with_data.description: Whether this version came from a restore that also put records back. `false` for an ordinary publish and for a restore of the document alone.

changes.description: Changes made since the restore point that were reverted.

records_deleted.description: Records created since the restore point that were deleted.

robots_gone.description: Records of robots that were deleted since, which could not come back.

reverted_totals.description: What putting the records back did, in all the collections together, so that the history of versions can say what came back. Null unless `with_data`.

source.description: The document as it was published, as text.

collections.description: The collections of the app by key, at most 50. Nothing under `collections:` (null) means none.

propertyNames.description: A collection key or a field key: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$`. Keys appear in URLs, filters and record bodies; `label` is the text people read.

label.description: A name for people to read. It may change at any time; the key is what code uses.

description.description: Free text that explains the collection to people.

binding.description: `global`: records belong to the app and no robot. `per_robot`: every record belongs to one robot (system field `robot_id`, fixed when the record is created). `one_per_robot`: every robot of the app has exactly one record, which Fleetless creates itself.

display.description: A template that names a record in lists, references and titles, for example `{{name}} ({{location.name}})`. A placeholder is a field of this collection, a system field (`id`, `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`, `revision`, and `robot_id` on robot-bound collections), `robot.name` on robot-bound collections, or `<reference field>.<field of the target>`.

create.description: Roles that may create records. Has no effect on `one_per_robot` collections, whose records Fleetless creates.

anyOf.description: The key of an organization role, or a list of keys. A key that names no role grants nothing.

all.description: Roles that may do this to every record.

own.description: Roles that may do this only to records they created themselves.

update.description: Roles that may change records: a role key, a list, or `{ all, own }` to tell every record from the ones a role created itself.

anyOf.description: The key of an organization role, or a list of keys. A key that names no role grants nothing.

all.description: Roles that may do this to every record.

own.description: Roles that may do this only to records they created themselves.

delete.description: Roles that may delete records: a role key, a list, or `{ all, own }`. Has no effect on `one_per_robot` collections, whose records are never deleted through the API.

access.description: Which roles may read, create, update and delete the records of this collection. A missing key grants that action to nobody; developers and server keys can always do everything.

description.description: Free text that explains the field to the people who fill it in.

required.description: A new record must set this field, and an update may not clear it.

unique.description: `true`: no two records hold the same value, within the collection (`global`) or within one robot (`per_robot`, `one_per_robot`). `collection`: on a robot-bound collection, across all robots. Empty values never collide. Not allowed on `boolean` and `json` fields.

default.description: The value a record gets when it does not set this field. It must itself be a valid value of the field.

max_length.description: Longest value in characters. Default 255, at most 1000.

pattern.description: A regular expression in the RE2 subset, checked in unicode mode: lookahead, lookbehind and backreferences are not supported. At most 1,000 characters, and the cloud may also refuse a pattern as too complex (its compiled size is bounded; counted repeats such as `{n}` multiply it), which a document reports as an invalid pattern. The value must match somewhere in it; anchor it with `^` and `$` to match the whole value.
